decisions.statement: A gateway busy is not a gateway dead.
One health deadline serves adopting a gateway and watching one alike.
The port an adopted Claude points at is the only port a fresh gateway binds.
A holder of that port belonging to another agent is left running.
The gateway's error stream goes to a file rather than to the seat's terminal.
An error stream whose file will not open is discarded rather than inherited.

definition: spawning the oauth proxy, or adopting one already there
